Civil protection campaigns: make preparedness understandable

A civil protection campaign should help people prepare and find reliable information. This guide is for associations, community initiatives and communication teams. It focuses on understandable tasks, traceable sources and a realistic starting point.

Updated: 7 November 2026 · RedScore editorial team

On this page

  • Choose a concrete objective
  • Reach different households
  • An example four-topic sequence
  • Show sources and responsibilities
  • Offer one manageable action
  • Measure outcomes honestly

Choose a concrete objective

Define one learning or action goal. Asking people to check their water supplies is more specific than raising awareness. Choose the first topic, intended audience and practical help. Preparedness education is different from an official emergency warning. Make the purpose and publisher clear in the content and design.

Reach different households

Consider limited space, tight budgets, language barriers and support needs. Explain one action in short sentences and provide readable text alongside images or videos. Include printed information and personal contact points. A digital post alone does not automatically reach everyone.

An example four-topic sequence

Our editorial suggestion starts with water and existing supplies. A second contribution covers light and information during a power outage. Follow with important contacts and documents, then review an emergency backpack checklist. This is a RedScore example, not an official campaign schedule. Adapt the sequence and repetition to your audience.

Show sources and responsibilities

Link the original specialist source and identify the publisher. Separate your own suggestions from official instructions. Check recommendations and links before publication. Use third-party logos and campaign materials only under their applicable terms. Citing the BBK does not create an official partnership or endorsement.

Offer one manageable action

Ask readers to test a torch, write down a contact or record supplies. A public calculator or printable checklist can help. RedScore's public guides can be linked directly. This does not establish a partnership or an official local warning channel. Institutional integrations and white-label services are not promised here.

Measure outcomes honestly

Distinguish reach from completed preparation. Pageviews show interest, not a filled water store. Use voluntary feedback and understandable reporting. Collect only necessary data and respect statistics choices. Review unanswered questions and adapt future posts. Do not claim effects that have not been measured.
